[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Tuesday: Salmon Cakes with Asparagus Slaw - Shred leftover salmon, mix with panko breadcrumbs, egg, and seasonings; serve with asparagus slaw (chopped asparagus, diced red onion, lemon juice, olive oil).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Wednesday: Quinoa and Veggie Stir-Fry - Use leftover quinoa, add favorite veggies (bell peppers, broccoli, carrots), oil, garlic, ginger; optional protein (tofu, chicken, shrimp).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Thursday: Salmon and Asparagus Wrap - Whole wheat tortilla with leftover salmon, roasted asparagus, mixed greens, tzatziki sauce, sliced cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, avocado.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Friday: Quinoa and Black Bean Bowl - Cook black beans, add to leftover quinoa, top with diced tomatoes, shredded lettuce, diced avocado, salsa or hot sauce; optional grilled chicken or steak.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Other ideas: quinoa salad with chopped veggies, feta cheese, lemon vinaigrette; asparagus in frittata or omelette; salmon with Greek yogurt and dill for dip.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested healthy lunch ideas that are easy to pack and won't spoil easily:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Salads in a Jar - Layer mixed greens, veggies, proteins, nuts/seeds, and vinaigrette.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Whole Grain Wraps - Fill with roasted turkey breast, avocado, mixed greens; hummus, cucumber, sprouts; grilled chicken, quinoa, roasted veggies.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Rice or Quinoa Bowls - Cooked rice/quinoa topped with grilled chicken, roasted veggies, fried egg; black beans, diced tomatoes, shredded cheese; edamame, sliced cucumbers, pickled ginger.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Soup Containers - Large batch of soup (lentil, vegetable, black bean) in individual containers; add whole grain crackers or bread.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Mason Jar Meals - Layer cooked pasta, marinara sauce, veggies; mix cooked rice, grilled chicken, frozen peas.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Fresh Fruit and Cheese Boxes - Fresh fruit paired with a small block of cheese.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Hard-Boiled Eggs and Veggies - Boiled eggs with carrot sticks, celery, cherry tomatoes.
